BOOK ONE · LESSON 064

Don't ...! You mustn't ...!

不要……！你不应该……！

A bilingual picture-and-prompt lesson: nine numbered pictures (aspirins, medicine, a doctor, matches, the library, noise, a fast car, the window, a vase) each paired with a 'Don't ...! / You mustn't ...!' caption, followed by workbook practice on giving permission answers and negative short forms, plus grammar on rewriting Don't sentences with mustn't/must. 看图提示课：9幅编号插图（阿司匹林、药、医生、火柴、图书馆、噪音、快车、窗户、花瓶）各配一条「不要……！」提示，配合教材 permission 回答、否定缩略式练习，以及用 mustn't/must 改写 Don't 句的语法练习。

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Listen and answer the questions.

  1. 110

    Don't take any aspirins! You mustn't take any aspirins!

    不要吃阿司匹林！你不应该吃阿司匹林！

  1. 221

    Don't take this medicine! You mustn't take this medicine!

    不要吃这种药！你不应该吃这种药！

  1. 332

    Don't call the doctor! You mustn't call the doctor!

    不要打电话叫医生！你不应该打电话叫医生！

  1. 443

    Don't play with matches! You mustn't play with matches!

    不要玩火柴！你不应该玩火柴！

  1. 554

    Don't talk in the library! You mustn't talk in the library!

    不要在图书馆里谈话！你不应该在图书馆里谈话！

  1. 665

    Don't make a noise! You mustn't make a noise!

    不要弄出噪音！你不应该弄出噪音！

  1. 776

    Don't drive so quickly! You mustn't drive so quickly!

    不要开这么快！你不应该开这么快！

  1. 887

    Don't lean out of the window! You mustn't lean out of the window!

    不要把身体探出窗外！你不应该把身体探出窗外！

  1. 998

    Don't break that vase! You mustn't break that vase!

    不要打破那个花瓶！你不应该打破那个花瓶！

Written exercise A Rewrite these sentences using Jimmy.

Rewrite these sentences using Jimmy. 改写以下句子，用 Jimmy 作主语。

Rewrite each sentence with Jimmy as the subject.

The printed example rewrites 'I mustn't take any aspirins.' as 'Jimmy mustn't take any aspirins.' (I → Jimmy, keeping the rest of the sentence unchanged); items 1-6 follow the same pattern. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

Written exercise B Complete these sentences.

Complete these sentences. 模仿例句完成以下句子。

Complete each sentence following the example: fill the blank, then rewrite with 'You mustn't ...'.

The printed example shows 'Don't eat rich food!' → 'You mustn't eat rich food!'; the nine items correspond to the nine picture captions on page 127 and each has the same two-part answer. No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from the printed example and labelled suggested.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A Can I ...? You mustn't ...! and You must ...!

These people are asking permission to do things. Write answers with the prompts. 以下各句用于表示请求别人的允许，根据提示作答。

Answer each permission request with 'No, don't ...!', 'You mustn't ...!' and 'You must ...', following the example.

The boxed example asks 'Can I get up?' and answers 'No, don't get up. You mustn't get up. You must stay in bed.' Each item is one answer field: don't-sentence, mustn't-sentence and the must-sentence from the prompt, in that order. The supplied key covers items 2-5; item 1's answer follows the boxed example.

B Short forms

Write these with negative short forms. 写出表示否定的缩略形式。

Rewrite each sentence using a negative short form.

C Situations

Read these situations. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。

For each situation, write what you would say.

Situational prompts; the supplied key gives model answers.
